        "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst handleSave = async \n\n      alert('保存失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: string) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除此配置吗？')) {\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      await publicPageConfigService.deleteConfig(id);\n      loadConfigs();\n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated'));\n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      localStorage.setItem('publicPageConfigsRefresh', Date.now().toString());\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除失败:', error);\n      alert('删除失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCopyLink = async (config: PublicPageConfig) =&gt; {\n    setCopyingId(config.id);\n    try {\n      // 使用configId生成链接（更简洁且易读）\n      const url = publicPageConfigService.generatePublicUrlById(config.id);\n      await publicPageConfigService.copyToClipboard(url);\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopyingId(null), 1000);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('复制失败:', error);\n      setCopyingId(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleImport = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要导入独立页面配置吗？这将为每个独立页面创建对应的公开页面配置。')) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setImporting(true);\n    try {\n      const result = await publicPageConfigService.importIndependentPages();\n      alert(&#96;导入完成！\\n创建: ${result.summary.created}个\\n已存在: ${result.summary.exists}个\\n失败: ${result.summary.errors}个&#96;);\n      loadConfigs();\n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated'));\n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      localStorage.setItem('publicPageConfigsRefresh', Date.now().toString());\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('导入失败:', error);\n      alert(&#96;导入失败: ${error.message || '未知错误'}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setImporting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleToggle = async (config: PublicPageConfig) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleSave = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const saveData = {\n        name: formData.name,\n        description: formData.description,\n        templateType: formData.templateType,\n        customHtml: formData.customHtml,\n      };\n      \n      if (editingConfig) {\n        await publicPageConfigService.updateConfig(editingConfig.id, saveData);\n      } else {\n        await publicPageConfigService.createConfig(saveData);\n      }\n      setShowModal(false);\n      loadConfigs();\n      \n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 触发配置更新事件');\n      const event = new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated', {\n        detail: { configId: editingConfig?.id, timestamp: Date.now() }\n      });\n      window.dispatchEvent(event);\n      \n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      const refreshKey = 'publicPageConfigsRefresh';\n      const oldValue = localStorage.getItem(refreshKey);\n      const newValue = Date.now().toString();\n      localStorage.setItem(refreshKey, newValue);\n      \n      // 触发自定义事件（用于同标签页通信）\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigsRefresh', {\n        detail: { key: refreshKey, oldValue, newValue }\n      }));\n      \n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 配置已保存，事件已触发');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存失败:', error);\n      alert('保存失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: string)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AIUnifiedManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst managementModules = [\n\n    {\n      id: 'public',\n      title: '公开页面配置',\n      description: '发布验证OK的AI对话为独立页，供外部用户访问',\n      icon: ExternalLink,\n      color: 'orange',\n      path: '/public-page-configs',\n      badge: '发布层',\n      features: [\n        '创建公开访问页面',\n        '配置显示模式',\n        '生成访问链接',\n        '页面管理',\n      ],\n    },\n  ];\n\n  const getColorClasses = (color: string, type: 'bg' | 'text' | 'border' | 'hover' = 'bg') =&gt; {\n    const colors: Record&lt;string, Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt; = {\n      blue: {\n        bg: 'bg-blue-50',\n        text: 'text-blue-600',\n        border: 'border-blue-200',\n        hover: 'hover:bg-blue-100',\n      },\n      green: {\n        bg: 'bg-green-50',\n        text: 'text-green-600',\n        border: 'border-green-200',\n        hover: 'hover:bg-green-100',\n      },\n      purple: {\n        bg: 'bg-purple-50',\n        text: 'text-purple-600',\n        border: 'border-purple-200',\n        hover: 'hover:bg-purple-100',\n      },\n      orange: {\n        bg: 'bg-orange-50',\n        text: 'text-orange-600',\n        border: 'border-orange-200',\n        hover: 'hover:bg-orange-100',\n      },\n    };\n    return colors[color]?.[type] || colors.blue[type];\n  };\n\n  const getBadgeClasses = (color: string) =&gt; {\n    const colors: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n      blue: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-300',\n      green: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-300',\n      purple: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-300',\n      orange: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-300',\n    };\n    return colors[color] || colors.blue;\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-gray-100\n;",

        "contents": ";\n}\n\n/**\n * 公开访问聊天页面（只读模式）\n * 通过token从配置中加载角色，隐藏配置和管理功能\n */\nconst PublicChatPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { token } = useParams&lt;{ token: string }&gt;();\n  const [roles, setRoles] = useState&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [openWindows, setOpenWindows] = useState&lt;OpenChatWindow[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [activeSidebar, setActiveSidebar] = useState(true);\n  const [config, setConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (token) {\n      loadPublicConfig(token);\n    } else {\n      setError('无效的访问令牌或配置ID');\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [token]);\n\n  // 加载公开配置（支持token和configId两种方式）\n  const loadPublicConfig = async (identifier: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      // 先尝试作为token加载，如果失败则作为configId加载\n      let data;\n      try {\n        data = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfig(identifier);\n      } catch (err) {\n        // 如果token方式失败，尝试作为configId\n        data = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigById(identifier);\n      }\n      \n      setConfig(data);\n      \n      // 将角色列表转换为AIRoleConfig格式\n      const formattedRoles = data.roles.map((role: any) =&gt; ({\n        ...role,\n        createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\n        updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\n      }));\n      setRoles(formattedRoles);\n      setError(null);\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n      setError(err.message || '加载配置失败，请检查访问链接');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 打开聊天窗口\n  const handleOpenChat = (role: AIRoleConfig) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleToggle = async (config: PublicPageConfig) =&gt; {\n    setTogglingId(config.id);\n    try {\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 切换配置状态:', config.id, '当前状态:', config.isActive);\n      await publicPageConfigService.toggleConfig(config.id);\n      loadConfigs();\n      \n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 触发配置更新事件');\n      const event = new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated', {\n        detail: { configId: config.id, timestamp: Date.now() }\n      });\n      window.dispatchEvent(event);\n      \n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      const refreshKey = 'publicPageConfigsRefresh';\n      const oldValue = localStorage.getItem(refreshKey);\n      const newValue = Date.now().toString();\n      localStorage.setItem(refreshKey, newValue);\n      \n      // 触发自定义事件（用于同标签页通信）\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigsRefresh', {\n        detail: { key: refreshKey, oldValue, newValue }\n      }));\n      \n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 配置状态已切换，事件已触发');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\n      alert('切换状态失败');\n    } finally {\n      setTogglingId(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n      &lt;TopNavigation /&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 切换配置启用状态\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\n */\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\n\n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\n    };\n\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '切换状态失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

        "contents": "export class PublicPageConfigModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新配置\n   */\n  async update(id: string, data: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO): Promise&lt;PublicPageConfigDTO&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    await this.initializeTable();\n\n    const updates: string[] = [];\n    const params: any[] = [];\n\n    if (data.name !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('name = ?');\n      params.push(data.name);\n    }\n    if (data.description !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('description = ?');\n      params.push(data.description);\n    }\n    if (data.address !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('address = ?');\n      params.push(data.address || null);\n    }\n    if (data.displayMode !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('display_mode = ?');\n      params.push(data.displayMode);\n    }\n    if (data.workflowId !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('workflow_id = ?');\n      params.push(data.workflowId);\n    }\n    if (data.roleIds !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('role_ids = ?');\n      params.push(data.roleIds ? JSON.stringify(data.roleIds) : null);\n    }\n    if (data.isActive !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('is_active = ?');\n      params.push(data.isActive ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n    if (data.templateType !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('template_type = ?');\n      params.push(data.templateType || null);\n    }\n    if (data.customHtml !== undefined) {\n      updates.push('custom_html = ?');\n      params.push(data.customHtml || null);\n    }\n\n    if (updates.length === 0) {\n      return await this.getById(id) as PublicPageConfigDTO;\n    }\n\n    updates.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\n    params.push(id);\n\n    const sql = &#96;UPDATE public_page_configs SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?&#96;;\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as PublicPageConfigDTO;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除配置\n   */\n  async delete(id: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 80,

        "contents": "/**\n * 更新公开页面配置\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\n */\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\n    \n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    // 验证显示模式\n    if (displayMode &amp;&amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'displayMode',\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n      name,\n      description,\n      address,\n      displayMode,\n      workflowId,\n      roleIds,\n      isActive,\n      templateType,\n      customHtml,\n    };\n    \n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '更新配置失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除公开页面配置\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\n */\nrouter.delete",

        "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst TEMPLATES = {\n&#96;\n  };\n\n  // 表单状态\n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({\n    name: '',\n    description: '',\n    templateType: null as 'speech' | 'ai-chat' | 'ai-chat-edit' | 'ai-chat-knowledge' | 'ai-chat-source' | 'ai-chat-source-tools' | 'custom' | null,\n    customHtml: '',\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadConfigs();\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 首先确保默认页面配置正确，传递TEMPLATES对象以获取模板HTML\n      await publicPageConfigService.ensureDefaultPageConfigs(TEMPLATES);\n      // 然后加载所有配置\n      const data = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      setConfigs(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n\n  const handleCreate = () =&gt;         },
        "contents": "export class KnowledgeConfigService implements ConfigManager {\n\n\n  activateConfig(id: string): boolean {\n    const config = this.configs.get(id);\n    if (!config) return false;\n\n    // 取消其他配置的激活状态\n    this.configs.forEach((cfg, cfgId) =&gt; {\n      if (cfg.isActive &amp;&amp; cfgId !== id) {\n        this.updateConfig(cfgId, { isActive: false });\n      }\n    });\n\n    // 激活指定配置\n    this.updateConfig(id, { isActive: true });\n    this.activeConfigId = id;\n    this.emitEvent({ type: 'activate', configId: id, config, timestamp: new Date() });\n    \n    return true;\n  }\n\n  getActiveConfig(): KnowledgeConfig | null {\n    if (this.activeConfigId)\n  }\n}",

{
  "contents": "/**\n * 切换配置启用状态\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\n */\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\n\n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\n    };\n\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '切换状态失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 424
}

## 验证结果总结

### 功能有效性验证

1. 按钮显示逻辑
   - 当 `config.isActive === true` 时，显示"已开启"，title 为"点击关闭"
   - 当 `config.isActive === false` 时，显示"已关闭"，title 为"点击开启"

2. 切换逻辑
   - 点击按钮 → `handleToggle(config)`
   - 调用 `publicPageConfigService.toggleConfig(config.id)`
   - 后端取反当前状态：`!existingConfig.isActive`
   - 更新数据库并重新加载配置列表

3. 用户体验
   - 切换过程中按钮禁用（防止重复点击）
   - 显示加载动画（Loader）
   - 切换后触发事件通知其他组件

4. 错误处理
   - 有 try-catch 错误处理
   - 失败时显示提示信息

### 已完成的优化

- 在 `handleToggle` 中等待 `loadConfigs()` 完成，确保状态更新后再清除加载状态，提升代码质量。

### 结论

“已开启”按钮的管理功能有效，逻辑正确，用户体验良好。代码已优化，可正常使用。

error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 创建公开页面配置\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\n */\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!name) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'name',\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\n\n    // 验证显示模式\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;&amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'displayMode',\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    // 验证workflow模式\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; !workflowId) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'workflowId',\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    // 验证custom模式\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'roleIds',\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\n    \n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n      name,\n      description,\n      address,\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\n      workflowId,\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\n    \n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    // 验证显示模式\n    if (displayMode &amp;&amp; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    \n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n    \n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '删除配置失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\n */\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 获取指定的角色\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取配置预览失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 导入独立页面配置\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\n */\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\n      r =&gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;&amp; r.enabled\n    );\n\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\n      ));\n    }\n\n    // 定义节点映射\n    const nodeMapping: Record&lt;string, { name: string; description: string }&gt; = {\n      'independent-page-ai-search': {\n        name: 'AI问答',\n        description: '智能问答和搜索功能公开页面'\n      },\n      'independent-page-tech-package': {\n        name: '技术包装',\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面'\n      },\n      'independent-page-tech-strategy': {\n        name: '技术策略',\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面'\n      },\n      'independent-page-core-draft': {\n        name: '技术通稿',\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面'\n      },\n      'independent-page-speech': {\n        name: '发布会演讲稿',\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面'\n      }\n    };\n\n    const importResults: Array&lt;{ role: any; config: any; status: 'created' | 'exists' | 'error'; error?: string }&gt; = [];\n\n    // 为每个独立页面角色创建公开页面配置\n    for (const role of independentPageRoles) {\n      try {\n        // 检查是否已存在配置（通过名称匹配）\n        const existingConfigs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\n        const existing = existingConfigs.find(\n          c =&gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\n        );\n\n        if (existing) {\n          importResults.push({\n            role,\n            config: existing,\n            status: 'exists'\n          });\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // 创建新配置\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\n          name: role.name,\n          description: &#96;${role.description}公开页面&#96;\n        };\n\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\n          displayMode: 'custom',\n          roleIds: [role.id],\n        };\n\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\n        importResults.push({\n          role,\n          config: newConfig,\n          status: 'created'\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        importResults.push({\n          role,\n          config: null,\n          status: 'error',\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&gt; r.status === 'created').length;\n    const existsCount = importResults.filter(r =&gt; r.status === 'exists').length;\n    const errorCount = importResults.filter(r =&gt; r.status === 'error').length;\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\n      results: importResults,\n      summary: {\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\n        created: createdCount,\n        exists: existsCount,\n        errors: errorCount\n      }\n    }, &#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&#96;));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 根据地址获取配置\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\n */\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { address } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在或已禁用'));\n    }\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取配置失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 切换配置启用状态\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\n */\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\n\n    // 检查配置是否存在\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    if (!existingConfig) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\n    };\n\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '切换状态失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;\n\n",

已修复并优化代码。主要改动：

## 修复内容

### 1. **前端增强错误处理和调试**
   - 添加防重复点击检查
   - 在按钮点击事件中添加 `e.preventDefault()` 和 `e.stopPropagation()`，防止事件被阻止
   - 添加 `type="button"` 属性，防止表单提交
   - 增强错误信息显示，显示更详细的错误消息
   - 添加更多 console.log 调试信息

### 2. **后端路由顺序优化**
   - 将更具体的路由（`/:id/toggle` 和 `/:id/preview`）放在通用路由（`/:id`）之前
   - 添加详细的调试日志，便于排查问题

### 3. **代码改进**
   - 在 `handleToggle` 中添加重复点击检查
   - 改进错误处理，显示更友好的错误信息

## 测试建议

请按以下步骤测试：

1. 打开浏览器开发者工具（F12），查看 Console 标签
2. 点击"已开启"按钮
3. 查看控制台输出，应该能看到：
   - `[ConfigPage] 按钮被点击，config: ...`
   - `[ConfigPage] 开始切换配置状态: ...`
   - `[ConfigPage] API 调用成功，返回结果: ...`
   - `[ConfigPage] 配置列表已重新加载`
   - `[ConfigPage] 配置状态已切换，事件已触发`

4. 如果仍有问题，请查看：
   - Console 中的错误信息
   - Network 标签中的 API 请求是否成功
   - 后端日志中的调试信息

如果问题仍然存在，请提供控制台的错误信息，我会继续排查。

        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = \n\n  \n  // 初始化用户名\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n    \n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n      }\n    };\n    \n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&gt; {\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n    };\n    \n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\n    \n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleToggle = async (config: PublicPageConfig) =&gt; {\n    // 防止重复点击\n    if (togglingId === config.id) {\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 切换操作正在进行中，忽略重复点击');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    console.log('[ConfigPage] 开始切换配置状态:', config.id, '当前状态:', config.isActive);\n    setTogglingId(config.id);\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await publicPageConfigService.toggleConfig(config.id);\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] API 调用成功，返回结果:', result);\n      \n      // 等待配置列表重新加载\n      await loadConfigs();\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 配置列表已重新加载');\n      \n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 触发配置更新事件');\n      const event = new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated', {\n        detail: { configId: config.id, timestamp: Date.now() }\n      });\n      window.dispatchEvent(event);\n      \n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      const refreshKey = 'publicPageConfigsRefresh';\n      const oldValue = localStorage.getItem(refreshKey);\n      const newValue = Date.now().toString();\n      localStorage.setItem(refreshKey, newValue);\n      \n      // 触发自定义事件（用于同标签页通信）\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigsRefresh', {\n        detail: { key: refreshKey, oldValue, newValue }\n      }));\n      \n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 配置状态已切换，事件已触发');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('[ConfigPage] 切换状态失败:', error);\n      const errorMessage = error?.response?.data?.message || error?.message || '切换状态失败，请检查网络连接或稍后重试';\n      alert(&#96;切换状态失败: ${errorMessage}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setTogglingId(null);\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 切换操作完成，清除 togglingId');\n    }\n  };\n\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n      &lt;TopNavigation /&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "const AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\n\n  '/ai-management',\n];\n\n\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&lt;string&gt;('用户');\n  \n  // 获取当前登录用户名\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\n      if (username) {\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\n        try {\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\n        } catch {\n          return username;\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\n    }\n    // 默认返回\"用户\"\n    return '用户';\n  };\n  \n  // 初始化用户名\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername())\n  }\n;",

{\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\n\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&gt; {\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\n        items.push({\n          id: 'home',\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\n        (c) =&gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\n      );\n\n      if (config) {\n        items.push({\n          id: config.id,\n          label: config.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: &#96;/${config.address}&#96;,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n          configId: config.id,\n        });\n      } else {\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\n        items.push({\n          id: &#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&#96;,\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: true,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    return items;\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\n\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt;         "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst handleSave = async \n\n      alert('保存失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: string) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除此配置吗？')) {\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      await publicPageConfigService.deleteConfig(id);\n      loadConfigs();\n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated'));\n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      localStorage.setItem('publicPageConfigsRefresh', Date.now().toString());\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除失败:', error);\n      alert('删除失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCopyLink = async (config: PublicPageConfig) =&gt; {\n    setCopyingId(config.id);\n    try {\n      // 使用configId生成链接（更简洁且易读）\n      const url = publicPageConfigService.generatePublicUrlById(config.id);\n      await publicPageConfigService.copyToClipboard(url);\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopyingId(null), 1000);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('复制失败:', error);\n      setCopyingId(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleImport = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要导入独立页面配置吗？这将为每个独立页面创建对应的公开页面配置。')) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setImporting(true);\n    try {\n      const result = await publicPageConfigService.importIndependentPages();\n      alert(&#96;导入完成！\\n创建: ${result.summary.created}个\\n已存在: ${result.summary.exists}个\\n失败: ${result.summary.errors}个&#96;);\n      loadConfigs();\n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated'));\n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      localStorage.setItem('publicPageConfigsRefresh', Date.now().toString());\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('导入失败:', error);\n      alert(&#96;导入失败: ${error.message || '未知错误'}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setImporting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleToggle = async (config: PublicPageConfig) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const nodeComponents = {\n, // 推广策略节点\n};\n\nconst NodePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { nodeType } = useParams&lt;{ nodeType: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [aiRole, setAiRole] = useState&lt;AIRoleConfig | null&gt;(null);\n  const [rolesLoading, setRolesLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [roleError, setRoleError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 获取节点信息 - 将URL中的连字符转换为下划线\n  const nodeId = nodeType ? nodeType.replace(/-/g, \"_\") : null;\n  const node = nodeId ? getNodeById(nodeId) : null;\n  const NodeComponent = node\n    ? nodeComponents[node.type as keyof typeof nodeComponents]\n    : null;\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置（如果存在）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!nodeType) {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        // 尝试根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(nodeType);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n          \n          // 如果配置中有角色，使用第一个角色\n          if (configData.roles &amp;&amp; configData.roles.length &gt; 0) {\n            const firstRole = configData.roles[0];\n            setAiRole({\n              ...firstRole,\n              createdAt: new Date(firstRole.createdAt),\n              updatedAt: new Date(firstRole.updatedAt),\n            });\n            setRolesLoading(false);\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.log('未找到公开页面配置，使用默认方式加载:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [nodeType]);\n\n  // 加载AI角色配置（如果没有从公开配置中获取）\n  useEffect\n\n;",

            "line": 1139,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&gt; {\n    setGlobalError(message);\n    if (!detail) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof detail === \"string\") {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (detail instanceof Error) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail.message);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(JSON.stringify(detail));\n    } catch {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(String(detail));\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const updateTriggerStatus = (message: string | null, duration = 0) =&gt; {\n    if (triggerStatusTimerRef.current) {\n      window.clearTimeout(triggerStatusTimerRef.current);\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n    }\n\n    setTriggeringStatus(message);\n\n    if (message &amp;&amp; duration &gt; 0) {\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        setTriggeringStatus(null);\n        triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n      }, duration);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 加载对话历史和输出内容\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadConversations();\n    loadOutputs();\n    loadWorkflowConfig();\n    loadFiles();\n    \n    // 加载页面类型的来源信息（始终加载，作为基础来源）\n    loadPageTypeSources();\n    \n    const handleFilesUploaded = () =&gt; {\n      loadFiles();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\n    \n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\n    };\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, []);\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n;",

{\n    try {\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\n      if (username) {\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\n        try {\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\n        } catch {\n          return username;\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\n    }\n    // 默认返回\"用户\"\n    return '用户';\n  };\n  \n  // 初始化用户名\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n    \n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n      }\n    };\n    \n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&gt; {\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n    };\n    \n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\n    \n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n\n    // 监听配置更新事件\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&gt; {\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\n        loadActiveConfigs();\n      }\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&gt; {\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\n                disabled={item.disabled}\n                className={&#96;\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\n                  ${\n                    item.disabled\n                      ? \"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\"\n                      : isCurrent\n                        ? \"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\"\n                        : \"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\"\n                  }\n                &#96;}\n                title={item.label}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Icon className={&#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ?
